title: Psychometrician official-scope reconstruction, taxonomy modernization, and readiness gate

haya_doctor.missing_type_cause: The pinned HayaDoctor source contains the formerly reported contracts; the prior clean-checkout failure was an uninitialized/missing-submodule state.

patterns.family: missing study/source links and broken references
milestone additions and exact batch deltas

official_scope.current_exam_regime: PRC Professional Regulatory Board of Psychology Enhanced TOS under Resolution No. 02 s. 2023, applicable from June 2023; no later Psychometrician TOS supersession was located in the current PRC board register.
official_scope.current_tos_or_syllabus: Resolution No. 02 s. 2023, Annex B, Table of Specifications for Psychometrician
official_scope.effectivity: Effective immediately after publication; applies starting June 2023 examinations.

official_areas.name: Psychological Assessment
official_subareas: Psychometric Properties and Principles
Research Methods and Statistics
Uses, Benefits, Limitations of Assessment Tools and Instruments
Selection of Assessment Methods and Tools
Test Administration, Scoring, Interpretation and Usage
Ethical Principles and Standards of Practice

official_areas.name: Developmental Psychology
official_subareas: Perspectives on Nature and Nurture
Research Methods in Developmental Psychology and Ethical Considerations
Developmental Theories

official_areas.name: Abnormal Psychology
official_subareas: Manifestations of Behavior
Psychological Disorders and Specific Symptoms based on DSM-5
Theoretical Approaches in Explaining the Etiology of Psychological Disorders
Therapeutic Interventions of Psychological Disorders
Socio-cultural Factors and Ethical Principles in Diagnosing Cases of Abnormal Behavior
Global Health Crisis and Mental Health Law

official_areas.name: Industrial-Organizational Psychology
official_subareas: Organization Theory
Organizational Structures and Systems
Human Resource Development and Human Resource Management
Team Dynamics
Organizational Change and Development

superseded_scope_excluded: Board Resolution No. 19 s. 2014 TOS is superseded by Resolution No. 02 s. 2023.

old_taxonomy.root_cause: The four official areas were simultaneously used as the only active concepts; existing source/study clusters already contained finer evidence but taxonomy and coverage did not expose it.

target_taxonomy.description: Reliability, validity, fairness, measurement error, and defensible score inference.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.leaf_name: Research Methods and Statistics in Assessment
target_taxonomy.description: Research designs, descriptive and inferential statistics, item analysis, standardization, and test-development evidence.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.leaf_name: Uses, Benefits, and Limitations of Assessment
target_taxonomy.description: Purposes, benefits, limitations, and consequences of using assessment methods and instruments.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.leaf_name: Selection of Assessment Methods and Tools
target_taxonomy.description: Matching assessment methods and tools to purpose, population, setting, and information needs.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Standardized administration, scoring, norm-referenced and criterion-referenced interpretation, and responsible use.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.leaf_name: Ethical Principles and Standards of Assessment Practice
target_taxonomy.description: Consent, confidentiality, competence, security, communication, and ethical handling of assessment evidence.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Heredity, environment, culture, context, and individual variation in human development.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Developmental research designs, cohort and attrition issues, comparisons, and ethical participation.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Evidence-bounded use of developmental theories to interpret personality, cognition, social behavior, and change.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.leaf_name: Normalcy, Abnormalcy, and Manifestations of Behavior
target_taxonomy.description: Normal and abnormal behavior considered with social, cultural, functional, developmental, and contextual evidence.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Cautious differentiation of disorder and symptom patterns using the applicable current classification evidence.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Biological, genetic, learning, cognitive, stress, interpersonal, cultural, and interactional explanations of psychological disorders.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Appropriate, bounded discussion of intervention selection, application, and evidence for psychological disorders.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Cultural formulation, ethical diagnosis, communication, collateral evidence, and non-stigmatizing assessment.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.leaf_name: Mental Health Law and Global Health Context
target_taxonomy.description: Current local legal and public-health boundaries relevant to abnormal psychology and mental-health practice.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Organization theories and models used to interpret structure, leadership, communication, culture, and work behavior.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Organizational models, structures, role relationships, accountability, and alignment with work strategy.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Job analysis, selection, training, performance appraisal, engagement, staffing, and responsible HR decisions.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Team development, group processes, psychological safety, conflict, and team-performance improvement.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.

target_taxonomy.description: Organizational change, development, interventions, adaptation, well-being, and evaluation of change effects.
target_taxonomy.source_basis: PRC Annex B official subarea boundary plus existing BoardPrep study/source cluster; leaf label is BoardPrep-derived.
